## Definition of Done Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the project's architecture and naming conventions.
- [ ] Tests exercise public API, service or component seams.
- [ ] Expected results are independent constants or fixtures.
- [ ] Normal, boundary, conflict and failure cases cover the feature's applicable behaviour.
- [ ] Build and tests pass; every application file retains 100% statement, branch, function and line coverage.
- [ ] Lint passes without warnings, or the absence of a configured linter is stated.
- [ ] No real secrets, tokens or credentials are committed.
- [ ] Story/AC traceability and `docs/regression-cases.json` are current.
- [ ] GitHub Actions passes for the current head.
- [ ] All acceptance criteria are demonstrated, or remaining gaps are explicitly listed.
- [ ] An independent reviewer has posted the structured [peer audit](../docs/test-peer-review-template.md).
- [ ] Integration and staging/test-environment evidence is recorded.

<!-- Do not claim historical TDD, deployed behaviour or peer approval without evidence. -->
